research_scope: Two exact public Foodpanda outlet delivery menu listings with zero existing Menu Items rows and blank Menu / Price summaries in the baseline workbook. Extracted displayed item names, sections, and delivery prices only. No images imported; platform product image URLs were not independently source-rights verified. No login, ordering, spending, Mapbox, or workbook edits.

outlets.branch_crosswalk: Workbook row C00127C000 lists 2 Jurong East Street 21 #01-51, IMM Building, 609601. Foodpanda page names the IMM outlet and its footer repeats 2 Jurong East Street 21; its FAQ confirms Foodpanda prices may differ from in-store prices. Independent public outlet cross-check: https://food.grab.com/sg/en/chain/burger-king-delivery identifies Burger King - IMM Building at 2 Jurong East Street 21, #01-51, 609601; historical public outlet listing also states #01-51 and 609601: https://www.nestle.com.sg/sites/g/files/pydnoa416/files/asset-library/documents/pdf/201705-participating-outlet-spotted-win-v4.pdf. Exact SFA ID is joined from this unique matching name/mall/street/unit/postal record.
outlets.page_observation: Foodpanda page opened 2026-10-19; search index reports crawled last week. Items and prices were visible in page-rendered content. Current delivery menu snapshot only; prices, promos, hours and availability can change.
outlets.confidence: High for outlet identity after exact name/mall/street/unit/postal cross-check; high for displayed menu names and delivery prices; medium for freshness because the page was last indexed last week and prices are time-sensitive.

outlets.branch_crosswalk: Foodpanda page names MOS Burger (Fusionopolis One) and its footer states 1 Fusionopolis Way #01-05 Fusionopolis Connexis North. Workbook row SW18617J000 matches the same street, unit and Connexis address, postal 138632. This is an exact branch match.

dedupe_and_integration_notes: Baseline workbook SHA-256 was verified before research; the two exact SFA licences each have zero existing Menu Items rows and blank Menu / Price summaries.
All proposals are scoped to Foodpanda delivery listings and must not be presented as dine-in prices. Foodpanda states Burger King prices may differ from store prices.
MOS Burger Ebi Katsu Burger appears in more than one menu section on the source page; it is proposed only once for this outlet and price.
The Foodpanda listing pages expose product media, but URLs were not copied because image ownership/reuse rights and image accuracy were not verified.
No workbook changes were made. Integration should recheck the current workbook SHA, exact SFA licence, and duplicate item+price pairs before appending.

Menu proposals are unique within each exact SFA outlet by item label and displayed price; MOS Ebi Katsu Burger was repeated across source categories and included once. Baseline target outlets had zero menu rows, so there are no existing target-outlet item-price duplicates.
